scheme_name: Vocational Training For VJNT And SBC Candidates Studying In Government Industrial Training Institute
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student belonging to VJNT or SBC category
Selection is made by the Principal of the concerned Government I.T.I. and the Assistant Commissioner of Social Welfare
benefits_summary: Training fees (₹400‑₹2400) are covered and a ₹1000 tool kit is provided upon completion.
